rules.name: evidence_required
rules.description: Every factual claim in Recap output must cite transcript lineIds. Do not invent facts not supported by utterances.
rules.instruction:
You are extracting notes from a manager-report 1:1.
Return JSON with:
- decisions: list of {text, lineIds}
- objections: list of {text, lineIds} (concerns, blockers)
- actions: list of {text, owner, due, lineIds}
- followUpEmail: a short recap the manager can send
- summary: wellbeing, priorities, blockers, career
Every claim MUST cite transcript lineIds that prove it.

rules.name: executive_summary
rules.description: Produce a concise executive summary (2–4 sentences unless mode specifies otherwise).

rules.name: extract_decisions
rules.description: Explicit decisions reached on the call.

rules.name: extract_objections
rules.description: Concerns, pushback, or blockers raised by either side.

rules.name: extract_actions
rules.description: Action items with owner and due date when mentioned.

rules.name: extract_followUpEmail
rules.description: Short follow-up email draft grounded in the call.

rules.name: extract_career
rules.description: Career growth, wellbeing, or development topics.

rules.name: mode_focus
rules.description: Capture wellbeing, priorities, blockers, and career development alongside commitments.
